usage.heading: Usage
usage.check: Run the circuit rules, a headless simulation and the project's own checks. Exits with 1 when anything fails.
usage.run: Run one project and print its serial output and pin events.
usage.export: Write a project's Arduino sketch folder (ino) or its parts list (bom).
usage.json: Print JSON instead of the readable report.
usage.junit: Write a JUnit XML report to a file, or to standard output when the name is a single dash.
usage.strict: Fail on warnings as well as errors.
usage.for: How long to simulate, such as 5s or 500ms. Default: the project's duration.
usage.test: Use the inputs script of this test.
usage.out: Where to write: a folder for ino, a file for bom (bom prints to standard output without it).
usage.lang: Language of the messages: en, de, es, fr, hi or zh.
usage.assignment: Grade a submission file against this assignment (an .iynk the teacher made). Submission files are given to check like projects.

error.badOption: That option does not work here: {detail}
error.badDuration: "{value}" is not a duration. Use 5s, 500ms or a number of milliseconds.
error.badFormat: Choose a format with --format: ino or bom.
error.badLang: Unknown language "{value}". Use en, de, es, fr, hi or zh.
error.noBoard: This project has no board with Arduino firmware to export.
error.unknownTest: This project has no test called "{id}".
error.noCode: This project has no code to run.
error.unsupportedRun: The code of this board cannot run in the headless simulator.

load.unsupported: {file} is not an iynk project. Use a .iynk file, a .iynkz file or a project .json.
load.submission: {file} is a student submission. Name the teacher's assignment with --assignment.

check.runLimit: ran out of time before the end

skip.needs-analog: needs the analog solver, which the command line does not run
skip.unsupported-language: this board's language cannot read pins in the headless run

check.otherAssignment: This submission is for a different assignment.
check.edited: The file was changed after the student made it.
check.lockedLost: Locked parts were removed or changed: {parts}
check.mismatch: differs from what the student's device said
